title: 第2章 联系初代跑男团
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李辰坐在家里的沙发上正在刷抖音。

屏幕滑动，一个视频弹出来。

是他自己的二创剪辑。

背景音乐是悲壮的交响乐，画面是他撕名牌的名场面。

以一敌三，面对邓朝、鹿寒、王祖兰。

他秒撕王祖兰，然后旋转牛的出现又瞬间撕了鹿寒。

紧接着他举着名牌仰天大吼。

画面一转，是他最新一期被三个年轻人按在地上的场景。

弹幕疯狂滚动：“他老了他老了他老了。”

配文只有一行字：【大黑牛终究是败给了时间。】

李辰盯着屏幕看了很久，心里很不是滋味。

直到手机顶端弹出一条微信消息。

发信人显示的备注名，他已经很久没有见过了。

邓朝发来一段语音，语气带着笑：“辰，刚才有个人给我打电话，你猜他跟我说什么？”

“他说要重组初代跑男，还说能让我们恢复到巅峰状态，你说好不好笑？”

李辰一脸好笑的回复语音：“还有这种事，我看是疯了吧？虽然我们也很想重组，但显然是不可能了，年纪在这呢。”

邓朝的语音很快传来：“可是我答应了诶。”

李辰连发三个问号：“？？？”

“晨！你就不想再试试吗？最近我也刷到抖音上关于你的视频了。难不成你真就这么服老了？这个导演，真有能力把我们几个聚在一起！”

李辰这下真是诧异了：“真的假的？圈里的哪个导演，我怎么不知道？”

“我也不认识，但不妨碍人家有能耐啊。总之我答应了，大黑牛看你自己的了。”

李辰放下手机，陷入了沉默。

而另一边的邓朝也在沉默中。

太多年没有这种感觉了。

五哈的录制让他很享受，也很轻松。

首先是自己的节目，其次没有高强度的搏斗。

可关于撕名牌，在他心里依旧有着超级重要的地位。

他坐在保姆车里，窗外是横店灰蒙蒙的天。

想起刚才和吴凡的对话。

“朝哥，我想要邀请你回来再录跑男。”

邓朝当时就笑了，根本没当回事：“你知道我的档期排到什么时候了吗？”

“知道。”

“那你知道我现在录综艺什么价吗？”

“当然知道，而且我给不起。不仅是超哥，曾经跑男团的每个人现在的身价，我都给不起。”

电话那头顿了一下，显然没想到吴凡这么的直接。

“既然你都知道，你还来问我？”

“但我能让你变回当年的邓朝，当年撕名牌最巅峰的邓朝，而不是现在五哈的老邓头。”

邓朝的笑容僵在脸上。

吴凡接下来说的话，每一个字都像钉子一样扎进他耳朵里。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Chen was sitting on the sofa at home, scrolling through Douyin.

The screen slides and a video pops up.

It's his own second creation.

The background music is a tragic symphony, and the scene is the famous scene of him tearing off his name tag.

One versus three, facing Deng Chao, Lu Han, and Wang Zulan.

He tore Wang Zulan to pieces in seconds, and then the spinning bull appeared and tore Lu Han to pieces in an instant.

Then he held up his nameplate and shouted to the sky.

The scene turned to the latest scene of him being pinned to the ground by three young men.

The barrage scrolled wildly: "He's old, he's old, he's old."

The accompanying text only has one line: [Big Black Bull lost to time after all.】

Li Chen stared at the screen for a long time, feeling very uncomfortable.

Until a WeChat message pops up at the top of the phone.

He had not seen the note name displayed by the sender for a long time.

Deng Chao sent a voice message with a smile in his tone: "Chen, someone called me just now. What do you think he said to me?"

"He said he would reorganize the first generation of Running Man, and he also said he could restore us to our peak condition. Do you think that's funny?"

Li Chen replied with a funny look on his face: "Is it crazy that there is such a thing? Although we also want to reorganize, it is obviously impossible because of our age."

Deng Chao's voice came quickly: "But I agreed."

Li Chen sent three question marks in a row: "???"

"Chen! Don't you want to try again? I've also seen your videos on Douyin recently. Is it possible that you are just so convinced by old age? This director is really capable of bringing us together!"

Li Chen was really surprised now: "Real or fake? Which director in the industry, why don't I know?"

"I don't know him either, but that doesn't stop him from being capable. Anyway, I agreed. It's up to you, Big Black Bull."

Li Chen put down his phone and fell into silence.

Deng Chao on the other side was also silent.

Haven't felt this way in too many years.

He enjoyed the recording of Wuha very much and felt very relaxed.

First of all, it is my own show, and secondly, there is no high-intensity fighting.

But tearing off famous brands still holds a super important position in his heart.

He was sitting in the nanny's car, and outside the window was the gray sky in Hengdian.

I remembered the conversation I had with Wu Fan just now.

"Brother Chao, I want to invite you to come back and record Running Man again."

Deng Chao laughed at that time and didn't take it seriously at all: "Do you know when my schedule is?"

"I know."

"Then do you know what the price is for me to record a variety show now?"

"Of course I know, and I can't afford it. Not only Brother Chao, but everyone who has ever been in the boy band is worth what they are now. I can't afford it."

The person on the phone paused for a moment, obviously not expecting Wu Fan to be so direct.

"Since you know everything, why are you still asking me?"

"But I can make you go back to the Deng Dynasty of the past, the Deng Dynasty who was at the peak of his reputation, instead of the old Deng Dynasty of Wuha now."

Deng Chao's smile froze on his face.

What Wu Fan said next, every word pierced his ears like nails.
